summary: Added strict read-only view models and connection ports for HUD, politics, economy, directional relations, wars, diplomacy, and news, plus range and blocking-event helpers.

commands.evidence: 1 test file and 14 tests passed, covering null data, relationship boundaries/direction, and event blocking severity.

tests: Unavailable politics/economy/war data remains null or empty.
Relationship scores accept -100, 0, 100, and null and reject invalid values.
Directional relationship labels cannot be silently swapped in the fixture.
Only unacknowledged major/transformative news items block.
knownLimitations: Ports define the connection boundary only; production domain adapters are intentionally deferred.
